expectedIssues: Delivery fee text overlaps the delivery time text
reportedIssues: On the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the delivery-time and delivery-fee texts are drawn on top of each other ('25–35 min' overlapping '€0 delivery'), producing unreadable garbled text.
The bottom 'Popular right now' pizza card is cut off abruptly by the bottom navigation bar, hiding its title, rating and badges with no visible scroll affordance.
Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the first card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
In 'Fastest near you' the third card and its title ('Trattoria Piccol…') are clipped at the screen edge without truncation ellipsis, and the category chip row is likewise cut mid-chip.
Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, heart favorite buttons) have no visible text labels, which may leave them unlabeled for screen readers.
